title: How many take-up units are needed for a 20-tube stainless-steel-wire annealing furnace?
summary: A Suneng stainless-steel wire annealing proposal lists 20 independent muffle tubes, while the requirement specifies only at least 10 take-up heads. The key questions are how many wires run simultaneously, how many strands each take-up machine handles and whether each strand has independent tension control. Machine count is not the number of simultaneously active take-up positions.
